name: end-of-work
description: A band above the prompt that warns you before your closing time and tells you, once it has passed, how far past it you are. Reads today's closing time from your daily note when it has one.

closeAt.title: Closing time
closeAt.description: When your workday ends, HH:MM (24h). A closing time in today's daily note wins over this.

headsUpMinutes.title: Heads-up minutes
headsUpMinutes.description: How many minutes before closing time the quiet reminder appears.

weekdaysOnly.title: Weekdays only
weekdaysOnly.description: Stay silent on Saturdays and Sundays.

timezone.title: Time zone
timezone.description: An IANA time zone such as America/New_York. Empty uses this computer's local time.

workspace.title: Workspace folder
workspace.description: Absolute path of the folder that holds your daily notes. Empty uses the folder Claude Code was started in.

journalFolder.title: Daily notes folder
journalFolder.description: Folder inside the workspace where daily notes live, as <folder>/YYYY/MM-Month/DD-MM-YYYY.md.
